classes.name: CRD credit institution
classes.label: CRD credit institution
classes.definition: an undertaking whose business is to receive deposits or other repayable funds from the public and to grant credits for its own account as defined by the European Banking Authority (EBA)

classes.name: credit institution
classes.label: credit institution
classes.definition: an undertaking the business of which is to take deposits or other repayable funds from the public and to grant credits for its own account, and to which authorisation has been granted to operate within the European Union and European Economic Area countries (EEA)

classes.name: credit institution / investment firm
classes.label: credit institution / investment firm
classes.definition: classification specific to European financial institutions that designates them as credit institutions / investment firms as defined by the European Banking Authority (EBA)

classes.name: European Economic Area branch
classes.label: European Economic Area branch
classes.definition: a branch of a credit institution authorised in another European Economic Area (EEA) country that has the right to passport its activities

classes.name: investment firm
classes.label: investment firm
classes.definition: any legal person whose regular occupation or business is the provision of one or more investment services to third parties and/or the performance of one or more investment activities on a professional basis

classes.name: local firm
classes.label: local firm
classes.definition: a firm dealing for its own account on markets in financial futures or options or other derivatives and on cash markets for the sole purpose of hedging positions on derivatives markets, or dealing for the accounts of other members of those markets and being guaranteed by clearing members of the same markets, where responsibility for ensuring the performance of contracts entered into by such a firm is assumed by clearing members of the same markets

classes.name: non European Economic Area branch
classes.label: non European Economic Area branch
classes.definition: a branch of a credit institution whose Head Office is in a third country

classes.name: payment institution
classes.label: payment institution
classes.definition: a legal person that has been granted authorisation in accordance with Article 10 to provide and execute payment services throughout the European community

classes.name: Credit Institution Register entry
classes.label: Credit Institution Register entry
classes.definition: entry in the Credit Institution Register, a repository of credit institutions collected by the European Banking Authority (EBA) as provided by the various national banking authorities for those institutions that qualify
